rules: Coverage failures cluster on fundamental fields (roa, leverage, operating_margin, asset_turnover) pushed through long transforms (delta/argmax/mean at 126-252d) — quarterly reporting gaps compound at long horizons, landing at 0.82-0.88 four times this round. Keep fundamental-field windows shorter or expect coverage loss.

Cheap-screen failures were short-window (5d) deltas on slow-moving fundamentals (accrual_gap, operating_margin) — the signal itself is too weak (t 0.55-0.65) because these fields barely move day to day, not because the expression is costly. Use quarter-scale windows (21d+) when differencing fundamentals.

Dollar_volume smoothed at nearby windows (21d vs 63d) is redundant and trips correlation when both appear as separate terms in one expression. Space smoothing windows further apart or make one a transform of the other rather than two raw levels.

High/low/close range-position ratios (stochastic-style) are a saturated correlation cluster — three rejects this round were just role-swaps of high/low/close/dollar_volume inside the same ratio skeleton already in the archive. A genuinely different normalization is needed, not reshuffled inputs.

Grafting RANK($roa) onto an unrelated price/volume ratio via a bare multiply/divide reads as crossover_not_a_fusion (only 2 shared nodes) — happened 4 times. Combine actual evolved subtrees from both parents rather than tacking a rank leaf onto a fresh tree.

TS_DECAY_LINEAR(-$return, 3) is archive-saturated (already paired with an operating_margin z-score); two more suffix swaps on it both collided via archive_subtree. Leave this exact prefix alone and vary the decay window or base series instead.

Resubmitting a raw fundamental field alongside its already-archived RANK() form is a guaranteed correlation failure (rho=1.0). Check whether a ranked version of a field is already archived before proposing the raw field.

This round's strongest accept (fitness 3.96) contrasted the same ratio shape at two different smoothing windows and spread the ranks, while the weakest accept (0.107) was a generic reversal-rank times roa-rank fusion that barely survived. Favor same-shape/different-window spreads over generic two-factor multiplicative fusions.
